claims_supported: The implemented finite-hierarchy planner explicitly compares shared and split candidate assignments.
The highlighted legal triple supports an effect of the whole selected configuration under its fixed-input conditions.
attribution_limits: All current formal variant configurations retain static tree planning, so current G/D/C/D+C contrasts do not isolate the tree-planning contribution.
Existing candidates mode disables the tree DP but lacks the STATIC guide-cache guard; changing only MODE therefore also changes replanning frequency and congestion-dependent choices.
Historical A3/A2 results are separate evidence under their historical conditions and do not isolate this current architecture-adapted selected configuration.
delay_qualification: Only 2 of 530 eligible connections used complete two-sided delay scoring in this highlighted run; partially measured source costs can still affect fallback cases. This neither proves delay scoring caused the improvement nor proves it had no effect.
possible_future_control: If a causal tree-planning claim is pursued, use an independently registered on/off comparison that preserves candidate generation, static cache lifetime, timing model, parameters, budgets, fixed layouts and detailed-route integration; validate the enabled control against the frozen binary. This is a design note, not an added or launched experiment.
current_action: Preserve the frozen study and narrow component-level causal claims; complete the currently registered queue before final acceptance review.
